scope: Garrison fixed and expanded roster only
boundary: Source multiplier, hit count, target budget, damage type, direct/projectile delivery, ordinary projectile speed/lifetime, charge use and closed delayed/finite hit Buffs. Existing basic-attack geometry, selection order, interruption and damage snapshot model remains. Native pre-delay/hit-frame/retarget phase, invalid-target SP refunds, projectile timeout forced-hit semantics, talent/module closure and original VFX are not claimed. Ordinary Projectile.ActionController attaches Buffs before body actions; this does not establish melee hit order. The protected DEFAULT/EXTEND switch remains unresolved: finite slow/stun use the shared max-expiry model, and finite DEF keeps the existing strongest-per-key/source-expiry model; these refresh/priority policies are implementation boundaries. Heal-to-node native bridge is protected: next-heal uses existing heal_scale and shared healing consumers; native heal event frames, live/cached power reconciliation and 3D paracurve trajectory are not claimed. Accepted means complete supported replacement-body graph within these shared-runtime boundaries, not whole-operator completion.

findings.source: Existing Android arm64 IL2CPP snapshot; bounded method extraction, no new bundle extraction

verified.observation: The eligible normal branch calls _AttachBuffs at 0x2096b14 then enters the _RunActions branch at 0x2096a9c. The compiler matches ordinary SimpleProjectile controller fields; not generalized to melee.
NewBuff invokes the newly reset Buff.OnStart at 0x4da6570 before EnsureOverrideGroup at 0x4da6600 and OverrideGroup.Add at 0x4da660c. OnStart body itself is not readable in this binary.
For finite incoming lifetime, existing remaining time becomes max(existing remaining time, incoming full lifetime). No trigger timer reset occurs in this method. Entity.OnBuffExtend is called.
For finite incoming lifetime, incoming full lifetime is added to existing remaining time and lifetime. Entity.OnBuffExtend is called.

The branch at 0x4da595c calls _FillRemainingTime; when takeSnapshotWhenExtend is true it takes a new attribute snapshot and copies the incoming blackboard. Which override enum reaches this branch is unresolved.
refreshRemainingTimeWhenStackMax at Buff+0x94 is tested only inside the stack-count/max-stack branch, then gates _FillRemainingTimeWhenStackMax. It does not establish DEFAULT non-refresh behavior.

unresolved.observation: All five bytes at RVA 0x806cada are 0x30. The resulting targets all equal 0x4da5874, in the middle of a branch. The protected/scrubbed jump table cannot establish DEFAULT, EXTEND or EXTEND_TIME mapping.
unresolved.disposition: One-shot evidence gap retained; do not repeat extraction or infer mapping from method names.

unresolved.observation: Method bodies expose queue, priority and refresh operations but the protected dispatch prevents full reconciliation for each enum.
unresolved.disposition: Current finite slow/stun max-expiry and DEF strongest-per-key/source-expiry conventions remain explicit simulation boundaries.

findings.implementationBoundary: Only complete source graphs matched by the compilers are bound. No whole-operator completion or exact native refresh/priority equivalence is claimed. Periodic cached-damage/DP Buffs with unresolved override dispatch remain rejected.
